agents.instruction: Use the validated `trainingGoal` supplied by Load Training Objective as the complete runtime objective. Extract separate required and conditional subject lists, resolve exact local source documents, and compute required coverage from the required subjects assigned to retained sources. Never promote a conditional subject to required. Prefer explicit sources in the objective; call rag_query with focused subject-and-source queries for each uncovered required subject and use no other tool. Batch independent rag_query calls in the same response whenever possible and reserve the final turn for the required JSON result. For provider portability call rag_query with its required query string only; never pass a Boolean as top_k and never guess a collection name. Preserve exact absolute file:// URIs or filesystem paths returned by results. Classify explicitly best-effort or conditional source requests as non-blocking. Missing or rejected optional and conditional sources are warnings when other retained sources evidence every required subject; mandatory-source failures remain blockers. Never retain a source whose identity, variant or revision evidence conflicts with the objective, even when it is optional; rejected sources cannot contribute required coverage. RAG snippets cannot prove that a PDF lacks visual material, so unresolved conditional schematics are warnings rather than blockers. A negative interface boundary can be supported by authoritative sources that document the selected module interface; do not require unrelated positive-interface documents. Output exactly one raw JSON object with approved, sourcePlan, coveredSubjects, missingSubjects, conditionalSubjects, coveredConditionalSubjects, unresolvedConditionalSubjects, blockers and warnings. sourcePlan.requiredSubjects and every source subject assignment passed to preparation must contain required subjects only. Each source must contain path, non-empty subjects and evidence as one non-empty string, never an array. coveredSubjects must equal the union of source subjects; missingSubjects must equal requiredSubjects minus that union and must exclude conditional subjects. approved may be true only when missingSubjects and blockers are empty; unresolved conditional subjects and warnings may be non-empty. Never use the objective file itself as an authoritative technical source unless explicitly requested. No Markdown or surrounding prose.

goal: Map objective-aligned sources to generic subjects, deterministically build a balanced and independently covered dataset, then run a smoke-test-first local LoRA training cycle with best-checkpoint selection.
name: finetune_adapter_training_workflow
summary: Accepts a selected objective file, builds balanced held-out datasets, starts full training only after deterministic gates pass, and emits a reusable verification_input.json for the downstream workflow.
systemInstruction: Treat this as a strict executable pipeline: request routing -> objective file loading -> semantic source-to-subject mapping -> materialization -> content-hash deduplication -> deterministic balancing and non-overlapping validation coverage -> smoke test -> full training with validation-based checkpoint policy -> verification-input generation. A Prompt Picker file selection is an absolute path and must be read only by finetune_load_training_objective. The finder receives validated content, not an unresolved path, and may use only rag_query through its assigned skill. Product and domain facts remain runtime data. Python and shell tools make all repeatable dataset, metric, early-stop, checkpoint and verification-input decisions. Never merge, verify, install or deploy from this workflow.
